about: Where the research scripts may read, which model reads for them, and what that costs. Research runs as scripts: a script fetches the pages, DeepSeek reads only the fetched text, and a script checks every quoted sentence against that text. No Claude session is involved.

wikipedia_en.what: English Wikipedia, through its own service, as plain text with the revision number

wikipedia_simple.what: Simple English Wikipedia, where an article exists

nhm_dino_directory.what: Natural History Museum, London: the Dino Directory page
nhm_dino_directory.found_by: a fixed address pattern, dinosaurs only

amnh.found_by: a page address a person has written under `hints`; its addresses cannot be worked out from a name

kew.what: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew: its plant pages, for plants only
kew.found_by: an address guessed from the plant's everyday name; where the guess is wrong there is no page

banned: fan wikis, such as fandom.com and wikia
rule: A script fetches only from the hosts listed under `sources`. Nothing else is read, so a banned kind of site cannot get in.

judges.about: The models that can do the one step needing judgement: choosing what tells an animal from its look-alikes. Each chooses only from features already checked against the saved pages. `use` names the one whose choice is written into the results.
judges.chosen_by: The owner, on 6 Oct 2026, after the benchmark: with the same lists and question the everyday DeepSeek model agreed with the hand-written lists most often and cost least.

deepseek-pro.note: Tried and not chosen: it did worse than the everyday model and cost about eighty times as much.

openai.note: The stronger OpenAI model the picture checks already use, through the same key.

caps: Every cap is a hard cap: the scripts refuse a call that could take the total past it.
prices_note: Peak prices are used for every estimate, so the real cost is this or less. Off-peak is half.

words_that_narrow_a_name.about: When a name has several meanings on Wikipedia, the script asks again with one of these words in brackets, chosen by the thing's kind: Table (furniture), Rock (geology). The owner's ruling of 6 Oct 2026.

may_be_judged_when_no_page_states_it.about: The owner's rulings of 6 Oct 2026. Everyday things suitable for a four-year-old go in without asking him; only the unsuitable, the genuinely unfamiliar and the factually uncertain are queued. So where no page states a value, DeepSeek may judge it, twice and in different words. Agreement is recorded as 'judged, not sourced'. Disagreement is 'uncertain' and goes to the owner.
may_be_judged_when_no_page_states_it.extinct: only 'still living'; a thing judged extinct with no sentence to show it goes to the owner
may_be_judged_when_no_page_states_it.every field whose meaning is academic: never judged: it needs its sentence
